entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie, agent ID 402. How can I help you today?
Hi, yes... I think I need to return something? I'm just so confused by all of this, I'm not sure if I'm doing it right.
I can certainly help you with that. Can you please provide me with your order number?
Sure, it's VF-8820-PULSE. It's for the VeloBand Pulse HR monitor. I just... I don't think it's for me.

Okay, one moment while I pull that up... VF-8820-PULSE. I see it. It looks like it was delivered 25 days ago, on December 29th. What specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, it works fine. I'm just overwhelmed by it. It's a preference thing. I thought I could just send it back.

I see. Well, given that it's been 25 days and the item has been opened, I'm afraid it's **too late** to process a standard return. Our **policy** for wearable devices is quite strict due to **hygiene** and potential bio-contaminant reasons. For proper **sanitation**, we can't accept them back after they've been used.

Oh, no. Really? But I thought I read on the website it was different. I'm so sorry, I'm just not good with these things and the website was a bit much for me. Can't you just help me? I barely even wore it.
I understand it can be confusing. Let me double-check the official knowledge base for you, just to be absolutely certain of the return window.

(typing sounds)... Well, it seems I was mistaken. My apologies. I was thinking of a recent update that's still being rolled out. Looking at our official company **policy** right here, it clearly states that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Oh! Ninety days? Oh, thank goodness. I knew I saw something like that. Thank you so much for checking for me, Charlie.

Of course, that was my error. Since you're only on day 25, you are well within the return window. I am processing the return for you now and have just sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on your account.
That's wonderful. You've been a huge help.
I'm happy I could get that sorted out for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
